#include <string>

    string in, out;
    cin >> in;
    int lng = in.length();
    out = "";
    bool at = false;
    for (int i = 0; i < lng; ) {
        if (i == 0) {
            out += in[0];
            i++;
            continue;
        }
        if (!at && i < lng - 2 && in[i] == 'a' && in[i+1] == 't') {
            out += "@";
            at = true;
            i += 2;
        } else if (i < lng - 3 && in.substr(i, 3) == "dot") {
            out += ".";
            i += 3;
        } else {
            out += in[i];
            i++;
        }
    }
    cout << out << endl;
    return 0;
}

#include <iostream>
#include <string>
using namespace std;

string process(const string& in, int i, bool& at) {
    if (i >= (int)in.length()) return "";
    if (!at && i < (int)in.length() - 2 && in[i] == 'a' && in[i+1] == 't') {
        at = true;
        return "@" + process(in, i + 2, at);
    } else if (i < (int)in.length() - 3 && in.substr(i, 3) == "dot") {
        return "." + process(in, i + 3, at);
    } else {
        return in[i] + process(in, i + 1, at);
    }
}

int main() {
    string in;
    cin >> in;
    if (in.empty()) {
        cout << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    bool at = false;
    string out = in[0] + process(in, 1, at);
    cout << out << endl;
    return 0;
}
